svg.text: Architecture of the IEFT-IR Routing Simulation Framework
System decomposition, component interactions, and execution pipeline verified against codebase implementation
LAYER 1: SIMULATION SETUP & TOPOLOGY INITIALIZATION (backend/main.py, backend/engine.py, backend/simulation/)
• Network: nodes N=28 [default], gateway=0, rounds R=80, seed=7 | k=2 (target, heuristic)
• Energy: E_init=100.0 J, tx_cost=0.65 J, rx_cost=0.18 J, threshold=25.0%
• Spatial Unit Square: Uniform placement G(n, r) with pos (x, y); nearest-component stitching
• Edge Augmentation: Best-effort candidate links toward target k (actual connectivity measured)
• State Containers: Node models (simulation/models.py), energies[n], cumulative depletion[n]
Active topology graph active = G.copy() & initial node states
LAYER 2: ENERGY STATE & ROUTING-COST EVALUATION (backend/engine.py: route_weight)
Edge Cost Function: route_weight(G, u, v, mode, energies, depletion, cfg)
[Default: use_weighted_route=False] C(u, v) = tx_cost · (1 + d²) + 2.4 / max(0.02, E_v / E_init) + 3.0 · (D_v / E_init)
[Optional: use_weighted_route=True] C(u, v) = tx_cost · (1 + d²) + w_e · (2.4 / e_v) + w_d · (3.0 · drain) + w_r · (1.0 - κ / k)
Evaluates transmission cost T(u,v), residual energy ratio e_v, cumulative drain D_v, and measured connectivity κ = _get_cached_connectivity(G).
Evaluated link costs C(u, v) dispatched to active routing algorithm
LAYER 3: ROUTING ALGORITHM EXECUTION & RECOMPUTATION POLICIES (backend/engine.py, backend/simulation/routing.py)
compute_path() with Localized Invalidation & State Caching
Active paths table paths[src] passed to per-round forwarding engine
LAYER 4: SIMULATION ROUND EXECUTION & PACKET FORWARDING (backend/engine.py)
Active edge existence & positive node battery
• Battery Update: E_v = max(0, E_v - cost)
• Route Advertisements: 32 bytes / hop on path
Node battery depletion & round progression triggers
LAYER 5: FAULT INJECTION, DEPLETION EVENTS & FEEDBACK LOOPS (backend/engine.py)
• Failure Mode: Articulation point or random
• Deactivates target node from active topology
• Preemptively shifts routes before node exhaustion
• Node added to dead set, removed from active
Feedback Loop: Invalidation trigger to IEFT-IR / Baselines
LAYER 6: PERFORMANCE METRIC COLLECTION & STATISTICAL AGGREGATION (backend/engine.py)
JSON metric payload assembled for REST API
LAYER 7: FASTAPI BACKEND SERVICES & REACT VISUALIZATION DASHBOARD (backend/main.py, frontend/)
Executes single-algorithm trajectory across R rounds
Executes multi-seed paired benchmark across SP, EA, IEFT-IR
Performs real intermediate failure & IEFT-IR route repair
• Real CPU repair latency & route shift readout
Every module, cost formula, algorithm policy, and metric has been audited and verified against backend/ and frontend/ source files.
